author: ETA PRIME
description:
In this video, we are putting together a custom Small Form Factor (SFF) Steam Machine running SteamOS. This Mini-ITX build was put together to out-perform the top-tier official Steam Machine, and it delivers 1.5x the performance while costing roughly $200 less. We go over the complete assembly process, install the official SteamOS recovery image, and test out heavy-hitting games at 1440p and 4K natively.
